name: Killed by EA
description: A searchable graveyard of the studios, games' online services, and projects Electronic Arts has closed, retired, or cancelled, with dates, a source for every entry, and the shutdowns still to come.
problem: When an EA studio closes or a game's online services are retired, the record is scattered across years of news posts; EA's own service-updates page no longer lists games, so players can't easily check what has gone dark, what is about to, or what came before.
